---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose a new capability or improvement
title: "[FEATURE]"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What can't you do today? Describe the gap, not the solution yet.

## Proposed solution

What would you add or change? Which script(s) or folder(s) does it touch?

## Alternatives considered

Anything else you tried or looked at instead (a post-install step, another tool, manual process)?

## Scope check

- [ ] This fits the native-install design — no Docker required as the default path
- [ ] This can work on all three platforms (Windows / macOS Intel / Raspberry Pi), or is
      documented as a deliberate platform exception
- [ ] This doesn't require machine- or organization-specific assumptions to be useful to other users

## Additional context

Logs, screenshots, links to relevant documentation, whatever helps.
